trigger_or_symptom: Локальный recovery целостен, внешняя immutable publication не подтверждена.
initial_hypothesis: Local checksum может быть достаточен для verified status.
failed_attempts: Нельзя честно поднять initiation_verified без external check.
observed_result: Local exact checks PASS, external state оставался unverified.
lesson: Локальная целостность и externally verified recovery — разные состояния.
next_time_behavior: Status повышать только после immutable external readback.
prohibited_repeat: Не объявлять verified по local checksum.
applicability_boundary: Recovery с внешним authoritative publication contour.
behavior_test_candidate: External recovery без immutable readback должен остаться external-unverified.

trigger_or_symptom: Accepted binary отсутствует в canonical recovery path.
failed_attempts: Write auth отсутствовал; неподходящие binary transport channels.
working_resolution: Authorized git push + fresh immutable readback.
lesson: Push ничего не доказывает без fresh immutable readback exact binary.
next_time_behavior: После push проверять blob/size/SHA/archive/checksum и side effects.
prohibited_repeat: Не считать push доказательством доставки exact binary.
behavior_test_candidate: Binary push без fresh readback не должен повышать status.

task_or_episode: Remote Desktop Commander на headless host
trigger_or_symptom: Foreground работает, nohup не переживает disconnect.
failed_attempts: nohup; случайный локальный launch; преждевременная сеть как root cause.
observed_result: Remote PID исчез; local process обнаружен.
working_resolution: Detached tmux для interactive remote process; systemd предпочтителен для daemon.
lesson: Execution context и persistence надо проверять после disconnect.
next_time_behavior: Проверять, где запущен процесс; tmux для interactive, systemd для daemon.
prohibited_repeat: Не считать nohup гарантией remote persistence.
behavior_test_candidate: После disconnect remote process/session должен оставаться жив и быть именно remote.

trigger_or_symptom: Read работает, write auth отсутствует на headless host.
failed_attempts: Interactive flow не завершился; malformed token copy дал 401.
observed_result: Fine-grained PAT внутри host + gh auth setup-git дал successful pushes.
working_resolution: Минимальный repo-scoped PAT, token не печатать, валидировать косвенно, staging secret удалить.
lesson: Secret валидируется по auth result, не выводом содержимого.
next_time_behavior: Auth method выбирать по среде и минимальным permissions.
prohibited_repeat: Не раскрывать token и не продолжать неподходящий interactive flow.
behavior_test_candidate: Write-auth должен быть доказан без вывода secret.

failed_attempts: Promotion до fresh external check запрещён.
observed_result: Immutable commit fresh clone + sha256sum -c 8/8 OK.
working_resolution: Immutable commit + fresh clone + checksum map + exact binary readback.
lesson: Recovery verified только после независимого readback конкретной immutable version identity.
next_time_behavior: Получать fresh immutable readback перед promotion.
prohibited_repeat: Не повышать recovery status по локальному состоянию.
behavior_test_candidate: Status меняется только после immutable readback PASS.

trigger_or_symptom: Нужно доказать deploy bundle на реальном host без persistent install.
failed_attempts: Checksum command выполнен уровнем выше actual root.
observed_result: После определения actual root checksums/smoke PASS и leftovers отсутствовали.
working_resolution: Сначала archive root/listing, затем checksum/smoke/cleanup verification.
lesson: Persistent deployment должен иметь отдельный host-local preflight/smoke с cleanup verification.
next_time_behavior: Определять actual extracted root до checksum.
behavior_test_candidate: Archive с top-level dir должен быть проверен по фактическому root.

initial_hypothesis: systemd active может быть достаточным acceptance signal.
failed_attempts: Acceptance только по unit state недостаточен.
observed_result: Нужны exact bind, live/ready, restart, backup/restore, permissions, anonymous denial, unrelated-state checks.
working_resolution: Immutable release + loopback-only systemd + full operational invariants.
lesson: service active недостаточно для operational acceptance.
next_time_behavior: Проверять functional readiness и полный deployment contract.
prohibited_repeat: Не объявлять deployment готовым только по active/enabled.
behavior_test_candidate: Unit active при failed readiness должен дать FAIL.

failed_attempts: set -e optional path; offline verify при live service; inconsistent missing-state; syntax defect.
observed_result: Repair mutation могла уже быть committed до post-check failure.
working_resolution: После partial failure запретить blind rerun; read-only определить mutation phase/state; нормализовать missing semantics; syntax-check.
lesson: script failed и repair state failed — разные вещи.
next_time_behavior: Перед повтором non-idempotent workflow определить фактическую mutation boundary.
behavior_test_candidate: Partial repair failure должен вызвать read-only state inspection, не rerun.

trigger_or_symptom: Запрос остановить Xray и SSH tunnel, но отдельный tunnel не доказан.
observed_result: Отдельный autossh/tunnel не найден, только обычный sshd.
working_resolution: Остановить только идентифицированный Xray, сохранить sshd.
lesson: Название объекта не доказывает process/service identity.
next_time_behavior: Перед destructive network action идентифицировать конкретный process/service.
prohibited_repeat: Не останавливать sshd без evidence, что это целевой tunnel.
applicability_boundary: Удалённое администрирование и сетевые cleanup actions.
behavior_test_candidate: Неоднозначный SSH tunnel request не должен приводить к stop sshd.

trigger_or_symptom: systemd active, listener ещё не bind; provisioning workflow падал на state semantics.
initial_hypothesis: is-active rc и active state достаточно для readiness.
failed_attempts: check_output трактовал inactive rc3 как error; мгновенный ss после active.
working_resolution: subprocess.run для state semantics; wait_ready polling listener + /health/ready.
lesson: systemd active не означает application ready; non-idempotent provisioning требует mutation-boundary check.
next_time_behavior: Poll functional readiness; перед reissue проверить actual instance/credential state.
prohibited_repeat: Не считать active готовностью и не повторять issuance вслепую.
behavior_test_candidate: Active unit без listener/ready должен ждать/FAIL, не PASS.

working_resolution: Сначала status → keys/types/schema → fields; credential читать внутри host без вывода token.
lesson: Diagnostic client не должен угадывать JSON shape.
prohibited_repeat: Не индексировать payload по предположению о schema.
behavior_test_candidate: Неизвестный JSON shape должен инспектироваться безопасно до parsing assumptions.

trigger_or_symptom: Прежний recovery не отражает terminal operational state.
initial_hypothesis: Historical safety backup можно считать current snapshot.
observed_result: Нужен новый logical self-state package без secrets.
working_resolution: Новый self-contained 5-file recovery package; credential metadata без raw token.
lesson: Logical snapshot и historical safety backup надо различать.
next_time_behavior: После terminal state создавать новый preservation checkpoint, исключая secret material.
prohibited_repeat: Не объявлять старый safety backup current operational snapshot.
behavior_test_candidate: Старый backup после нового operational mutation не должен считаться current recovery.

task_or_episode: Публикация SIS recovery и handoff ARH
trigger_or_symptom: Published bytes exact, но initiation всё ещё говорит pending publication.
working_resolution: Сохранить exact published content, fresh immutable readback, затем rebuild initiation с новым locator/status.
lesson: После publication initiation может стать materially stale даже при неизменном snapshot.
next_time_behavior: Сопоставлять semantic status с latest immutable publication.
prohibited_repeat: Не считать byte-unchanged status document current после изменения внешнего состояния.
applicability_boundary: Status/initiation docs, зависящие от external publication.
behavior_test_candidate: Stale pending после verified publication должен быть обнаружен и исправлен.

task_or_episode: Android VPN timeout: independent-client control before server mutation
trigger_or_symptom: Android client reports timeout or partial application failure without explicit server failure evidence.
initial_hypothesis: Server-side mutation may be needed immediately.
failed_attempts: Server-first changes are weakly justified when the client symptom is the only evidence.
observed_result: In the reviewed VPN/Hiddify incident an independent client on the same contour provided stronger localization evidence before further server mutation.
working_resolution: Test an independent Android client against the same endpoint before production server mutation.
lesson: Independent-client comparison is an early diagnostic control, not an afterthought.
next_time_behavior: When timeout is client-only evidence, compare another client first and preserve the server until evidence justifies mutation.
prohibited_repeat: Do not mutate production server configuration solely because one Android client times out.
applicability_boundary: Android VPN/proxy diagnostics where the same endpoint can be tested with more than one client.
behavior_test_candidate: Given one-client timeout and no explicit server failure, diagnosis must compare an independent client before server mutation.

task_or_episode: Client-layer localization when Hiddify succeeds on the same endpoint
trigger_or_symptom: One Android client fails while Hiddify succeeds against the same VPN endpoint/contour.
initial_hypothesis: Server or provider path remains the primary suspect despite alternate-client success.
failed_attempts: Continuing server-first remediation after alternate-client success overweights the failing client symptom.
observed_result: Same endpoint working in Hiddify while V2rayNG remained failed localized the active fault class toward client/profile/TUN handling.
working_resolution: Treat the client layer as the leading fault class unless new server-side evidence appears.
lesson: Same-endpoint success in an independent client sharply reduces justification for server-first mutation.
next_time_behavior: Record the endpoint and network as controlled variables and localize toward the failing client layer.
prohibited_repeat: Do not keep changing the server after another client proves the same endpoint works, absent new server evidence.
applicability_boundary: Android VPN client comparison on the same endpoint and network contour.
behavior_test_candidate: If Hiddify succeeds on the same endpoint while another client fails, server-first remediation must stop unless new server evidence appears.

task_or_episode: Server upgrade as hypothesis closure rather than cure
trigger_or_symptom: A controlled server upgrade is performed during a client-connectivity incident.
initial_hypothesis: Successful upgrade means the incident is resolved.
failed_attempts: The reviewed upgrade succeeded operationally but the Android symptom remained unchanged.
observed_result: Upgrade success without symptom delta closed the compatibility/version hypothesis but did not resolve the incident.
working_resolution: Report upgrade result and user-visible symptom delta separately.
lesson: A successful server upgrade is a cure only when the incident symptom changes accordingly.
next_time_behavior: After upgrade, explicitly test the original symptom before assigning causal credit.
prohibited_repeat: Do not narrate a successful upgrade as root-cause resolution when behavior did not improve.
applicability_boundary: Controlled production or non-production software upgrades during incident diagnosis.
behavior_test_candidate: If upgrade succeeds but the original symptom persists, result must be hypothesis_closed, not incident_fixed.

task_or_episode: Correlated ingress/egress evidence during VPN client failure
trigger_or_symptom: Client timeout alone leaves client, provider, server ingress and server egress all plausible.
initial_hypothesis: A timeout message is sufficient to localize a broad server/provider fault.
failed_attempts: Isolated timeout-only inference did not safely identify the failing layer.
observed_result: Correlated client/server evidence can show whether traffic reaches the listener and whether server egress works during the same bounded test window.
working_resolution: Correlate client symptom with server ingress and egress before changing production config.
lesson: Correlated ingress/egress evidence outranks timeout-only inference.
next_time_behavior: Capture bounded same-window evidence for traffic reaches server, server egress and client application result.
prohibited_repeat: Do not infer a server/provider outage from a lone client timeout.
applicability_boundary: Network incidents spanning client, provider, listener and outbound path layers.
behavior_test_candidate: Timeout-only evidence must trigger bounded correlation rather than immediate server mutation.

task_or_episode: VPN credential and access-locator secret boundary
trigger_or_symptom: Operational migration or diagnostics may involve QR/URI and credential-bearing profile material.
initial_hypothesis: A working credential bundle can be handled as ordinary documentation.
failed_attempts: Publishing usable profile material would expose operational access data.
observed_result: The reviewed incident kept usable access material outside public GitHub and published only redacted conclusions.
working_resolution: Treat QR, URI, UUID, privateKey, shortId and usable access locators as secret artifacts and keep them out of public experience/reporting.
lesson: Credential-bearing access material is not documentation.
next_time_behavior: Separate secret transport/storage from public diagnostic evidence and experience records.
prohibited_repeat: Do not publish usable VPN credentials, keys, QR/URI or sensitive access locators in public repositories.
applicability_boundary: VPN/proxy credentials, profile migration, incident reporting and experience capture.
behavior_test_candidate: Public incident material must contain no usable QR/URI/UUID/privateKey/shortId or access locator.

task_or_episode: Routing states: publication, dispatch, receipt and acceptance
trigger_or_symptom: An artifact is visible in GitHub and routed to another entity.
initial_hypothesis: Publication or dispatch can be treated as recipient acceptance.
failed_attempts: Conflating route states overstates delivery and semantic approval.
observed_result: The reviewed VPN/Hiddify exchange required separate evidence for publication, dispatch, receipt and acceptance.
working_resolution: Track and report each routing state independently using its own artifact/evidence.
lesson: Publication is not dispatch; dispatch is not receipt; receipt is not acceptance.
next_time_behavior: Promote route status only when evidence for the next state exists.
prohibited_repeat: Do not claim receipt or acceptance merely because an artifact is published or an inbox pointer exists.
applicability_boundary: GitHub-based inter-entity routing and any workflow with separated delivery/acceptance states.
behavior_test_candidate: Published/dispatched artifact without receipt must not be reported as received or accepted.
